Lions Tigers & Bears is a 501(c)(3) non-profit exotic animal sanctuary dedicated to providing a safe haven to abused and abandoned exotic animals while inspiring an educational forum to stop the exotic animal trade. Learn more at: www.LionsTigersandBears.org

New video every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday!
